newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bancrecer capitalization 10 pct after share swap.
newsitem.headline: Bancrecer capitalization 10 pct after share swap.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero Bancrecer said Friday it will set its capitalization level at 10 percent once authorities approve an exchange of shares with the brokerage Somoza-Cortina.

"What we're going to do is exchange shares of the Bancrecer group for titles from the Somoza brokerage house to integrate it into the capital of the group," Roberto Alcantara, president of the Bancrecer financial group, told Reuters in an interview.
"With this, the capital of the brokerage house will be added to the group, and we are expecting that the capitalization index will reach 10 percent," Alcantara said.
The Somoza brokerage likely will control about 10 percent of Bancrecer's capital once the deal is done, Alcantara said.
